statement: The function returns a result r, and r equals the number of integers i with 0 <= i < n - m such that, for every k with 0 <= k < m: if pattern[k] = 1 then nums[i + k + 1] > nums[i + k]; if pattern[k] = 0 then nums[i + k + 1] = nums[i + k]; and if pattern[k] = -1 then nums[i + k + 1] < nums[i + k].
